messages:
mina: Heads-up — we need to align the user-facing error lexicon with the new gatekeeper routing layer. Specifically: quota vs capacity vs policy blocks. Thoughts on HTTP status vs structured hint fields?

ryan: I think keep standard status codes (429/503/403) and add a small structured body with a stable `error.code` string. SDKs can read that. 429 + `Retry-After` works well for quotas.

sanjay: 429 is fine, but product wants a human-friendly message and an action (upgrade/contact). Can we standardize `error.hints` array with short tokens? e.g. `["UPGRADE_PLAN","WAIT_24H"]` so console/SDK can map to copy.

mina: That implies a contract change. I'd prefer adding a minimal set of fields rather than full arrays to limit churn: `error.code`, `error.message`, `error.hint_url` and a small `x-rw-quota-reset` header.

elaine: From console POV we need consistent keys to map to badges and runbooks. Proposed badge buckets: info / warning / critical. Map reasons -> badge + short copy + help link.

tom: For routing semantics: should soft-degrade return 200 with a `degraded` flag, or return a non-2xx? I worry returning 200 for obvious failures will confuse downstream telemetry.

ryan: Soft-degrade where generation still happens can stay 200 and include `meta.degraded: true`. Real failures (blocked/denied) should be non-2xx.

sanjay: We already have 403 for auth/policy. For quota use 429. For capacity/overload use 503. Avoid inventing new status codes. Use header + body to disambiguate (e.g., `x-rw-fail-reason: CAPACITY_SOFT` or `CAPACITY_HARD`).

mina: Draft mapping I propose:
- QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> 429, body.error.code = "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", header `x-rw-quota-reset` (unix ts), `Retry-After` optional
- CAPACITY_DEGRADED -> 200 if degraded response produced with body.meta.degraded = true; otherwise 503 + error.code = "CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED"
- POLICY_BLOCKED -> 403 + error.code = "POLICY_BLOCKED" + `error.help_url`

(Example response snippet)
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-quota-reset: 1712345678
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": { "code": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "message": "Monthly token quota exhausted", "help_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/docs/quota" }
}
```

elaine: Console mapping notes: reason->badge: QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> warning; CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED -> critical for route-level badging; POLICY_BLOCKED -> critical with link to admin page. Also surface `retry_after` countdown in UI.

ryan: SDK changes: expose `error.code` as a string constant, and `error.meta` (freeform) for hints. Keep http status for infra decisions. We'll add a helper `isRetryable(error)` that checks status + code.

tom: Telemetry: include `error.reason`, `route_fallback` (bool), `client_tier`, and `sampling` flag. For stack traces only sample when `client_tier == enterprise` and `error.severity == critical`.

mina: Rollout plan: feature flag the new keys behind `gatekeeper_error_lexicon_v1`. Beta for two weeks on 10% of traffic, collect: counts by `error.code`, latency delta, and UX clicks on console help links.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of gatekeeper v2 to us-west completed :white_check_mark:

elaine: I'll draft the console copy templates (short + long + link). Keep short messages < 60 chars for inline badges.

mina: Good. I'll write an RFC with the concrete JSON schema and header list and open a PR. Any objections to the status assignments above?

ryan: LGTM

sanjay: +1

tom: +1

elaine: :thumbsup:
